status: predeclared before native22 and full21 calibration predictions
parents: Fixed development-selected native22 checkpoint per language plus fixed validation-selected full21 structured interpreter. No parent reselection.
training: Previously named development set becomes fusion fitting and grouped cross-validation data. This is an additional learned component, not an independent evaluation on its fitting data.
features: Native raw score and clipped logit; predicted conditional field probability vectors and predicted label one-hot vectors in ONTOLOGY order; native-score times each probability. No message text, source stratum, case identity, gold field or language indicator is a feature. Separate model per language.
folds: Five deterministic SHA256 folds over connected components of same normalized focal input and supplied pair_group. No claim of semantic-family independence. Parent models already used development for selection, so fusion OOF is not fully untouched end-to-end validation.
fit: Float64 weighted regularized logistic regression with intercept; per-fit feature mean/std, scale floor1e-8; equal formal/conversational x binary-class mass. Newton with Armijo backtracking; reject nonconvergence or nonfinite coefficients. Penalties0.1,1,10,100.
selection: For each penalty collect out-of-fold scores. Shared language threshold is minimum stratum positive score at permitted1% misses minus1e-8; invalid structured output abstains and counts as error. Rank first by meeting unchanged99% recall and5% false-review limits in BOTH strata, then lowest worst false-review rate, lowest summed false-review rate, strongest penalty tie. Refit selected penalty on complete development inputs; retain OOF threshold.
calibration: Persist selection, parent/input/code/protocol hashes and final coefficients before a separate process opens calibration. Score once. Both OOF development and calibration populations must meet unchanged limits. No adaptive calibration tuning.
runtime: Any qualifying fusion remains experimental until installed composite inference parity, reserved actual-runtime checks and product integration. No default change.
execution: Small NumPy CPU-only fit after full21 predictions exist; no neural model loaded. Does not interrupt native22, policy27 or installed runtimes.
